endpoint_contract: frozen-exact-synonym pre-mapper Top-1/Top-2; doctor-union reference capture; conditional aggregation conversion; diversity, echo, novelty, and paired history/aggregator contrasts

factor_isolation.aggregation: same frozen doctors and canonical union within history
factor_isolation.doctor_a: same cached raw response in both history conditions
factor_isolation.doctor_b_c: same prompt/vignette; discussion_history empty vs prior valid doctors
factor_isolation.rrf: canonical-concept RRF k=60; deterministic lexical tie break
factor_isolation.supervisor_constraint: select exactly two IDs from union; no candidate invention

failure_policy: intention-to-analyse; invalid doctors excluded without imputation; invalid supervisor is incorrect; no gold fallback
llama_provider_policy: balanced Groq/DeepInfra primary rotation; alternate on retry; no Novita
mechanism_endpoints: aggregation loss/rescue conditional on union exposure
payload_transmitted: candidate IDs/labels and panel ranks to supervisor
